name: Exercise feedback

title: "[Exercise N] "
labels: exercise-feedback
assignees: ''
---

## Which exercise

Exercise number and file (e.g. `exercises/exercise-3-implement-harness-fix.md`).

## What's unclear or wrong

Be specific — quote the confusing sentence, or describe exactly what step you
got stuck on. If you think a technical claim about Claude Code (or git, or
any other tool) is inaccurate, please include what you verified and where
(a docs.claude.com link or similar), the same way this repo expects
contributions to cite verification.

## What you expected instead

## Reference solution affected?

If this touches an exercise that has a reference solution on the `solutions`
branch, does that solution need updating too?
